answer: Each seat registers a meadow plot with a copper stake and a shallow basin. Each epoch a neighbour drops a stone at random; the seat records when the ripple reaches the bank and the echo off the soil, whose spectrum tracks grass height and moisture. Two seats sharing one echo curve are treated as a single operator and both deposits are lost. Code can fake a waveform, not a patch of ground: a forger needs a real plot, a sealed recorder, a season of growth, a witness who walked there. Ten thousand identities mean ten thousand plots and seasons, while a seat still earns one share.
